[LGRA.22.4] **Schema references.** At every schema-reference site — a pattern
head, `latest`, `emit`, `publish` — a schema is named by one of two
forms:

- a **bare `NAME`** resolving to a schema in local scope: declared in the
  compilation unit, or imported by `from lib import Schema`; or
- a **library-qualified reference** `p.NAME` (`plant.sensors.Reading`), where `p`
  is the path of a library the file imports, or an `as` alias of one
  ([LIMP.2.1.7]), naming a schema that library exports.

These positions are type positions, so no binding can stand there: every `.` in a
schema reference separates the library path from the schema. A schema from a
library is referenced only when that library is imported ([LIMP.1]); a schema
declared in the compilation unit needs no import. With no entity-suffix in pattern
position ([LADP.2]), the pattern head is LALR(1)-clean ([LGRA.22.3]).
